name: rANS (Asymmetric Numeral Systems)
definition: A lossless entropy coding method used to compress 4-bit symbols (half-bytes) into a byte stream. It replaces a range of 4-bit elements in a packed buffer with an rANS encoded bytestream.
summary: rANS is a fast, lossless entropy coding scheme that compresses 4-bit symbols into a byte stream, optimized for efficient parallel GPU decompression.
